facts.en: Attended Fictional Bruma School of Editions from 2019-09 to 2022-06.
facts.zh: 2019-09 至 2022-06 就读于虚构布鲁马出版学校。

facts.en: The credential awarded in 2022 is titled “Diploma Superior de Edición Aplicada” in the issuing school’s language.
facts.zh: 2022 年授予的证书在颁发学校所用语言中名为“Diploma Superior de Edición Aplicada”。

facts.en: The supplied English translation renders that title as “Higher Diploma in Applied Publishing”; the supplied Chinese translation is “应用出版高等文凭”.
facts.zh: 所提供英文译本将该名称译为“Higher Diploma in Applied Publishing”；所提供中文译名为“应用出版高等文凭”。

facts.en: The records contain no qualification-level assessment or bachelor’s-degree equivalency decision for that credential.
facts.zh: 记录中没有该证书的资格等级评估或学士学位等同性认定。

facts.en: For the final course project, assembled a 28-page fictional nature activity booklet using supplied text and images.
facts.zh: 在结课项目中，使用提供的文字和图片制作了 28 页虚构自然活动册。

facts.en: Personally laid out headings and captions; a classmate proofread the final course booklet.
facts.zh: 个人排版标题及图片说明；一名同学校对了最终课程活动册。

facts.en: Paid print-production clerk at Fictional Inkfold Press from 2022-09 to 2025-12.
facts.zh: 2022-09 至 2025-12 在虚构墨折印务任有薪印刷制作文员。

facts.en: Tracked proof versions, supplier delivery dates and approval emails.
facts.zh: 跟踪校样版本、供应商交付日期及批准邮件。

facts.en: Checked trim size and page count against approved order forms.
facts.zh: 依据获批订单核对成品尺寸及页数。

facts.en: Escalated colour discrepancies to the production manager; did not approve press colour standards.
facts.zh: 向制作经理上报色彩差异；不批准印刷色彩标准。

facts.en: Prepared printer handoff folders after the editor had approved final text.
facts.zh: 在编辑批准最终文字后准备交给印厂的文件夹。

facts.en: Uses page-layout software for template edits and PDF markup for proof comments.
facts.zh: 使用页面排版软件修改模板，并通过 PDF 标注记录校样意见。

facts.en: Created a proof-filename guide for the production desk in 2024-03.
facts.zh: 2024-03 为制作部门编写校样文件命名指南。

facts.en: The production manager approved the guide; the candidate maintained its examples.
facts.zh: 制作经理批准该指南；候选人维护其中的示例。

facts.en: In a 2024-05 desk review, 23 of 25 sampled proof folders used the approved filename format.
facts.zh: 2024-05 的部门审核中，25 个抽样校样文件夹有 23 个使用获批文件名格式。

facts.en: No earlier comparison sample or attributable cost saving was recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录较早的对比样本或可归因的成本节省。

facts.en: Completed a non-award online introduction to accessible documents in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年完成不授予资格的在线无障碍文档入门课程。

facts.en: Volunteered to set up tables for Fictional Fold Fair in 2023; this was separate from print employment.
facts.zh: 2023 年志愿为虚构折页集市布置桌子；该活动与印刷工作分开。

facts.en: Made a personal folding-card template collection in 2026 using original drawings.
facts.zh: 2026 年使用原创绘画制作个人折叠卡片模板集。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing imaginary storefront signs.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制想象中的店面招牌。

facts.en: The record contains no independent translation of the credential beyond the supplied title translations.
facts.zh: 除所提供的证书名称译文外，记录中没有该证书的独立翻译。
